title: data-decisions sidecar v1
description: A JSON file Phirewall writes next to a dataset twin (`<safe_path>.decisions.json`) so downstream tools read Phirewall's data-meaning decisions instead of re-asking. Only decisions in force appear: stale ones are excluded. Codes only, plus the agent's gated question text on open items: no cell values, no value lists, no counts of rows or patients. `prepared` is present only for prepared versions, whose ops are already applied to the twin and must not be re-applied. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored; adding an optional field or an enum code does not bump `version`.

contract.description: What this file is. A reader ignores a file whose contract it does not know.

version.description: Contract version. Bumped only on a breaking change (a field removed, renamed, retyped, made required, or its meaning or bound changed). A reader ignores a file whose version it does not know.

dataset.description: The Phirewall dataset name this sidecar belongs to: a prepared version's name, or the registered dataset's.

dataset_version.description: The data version the decisions were made against: the dataset's own version (a hash of its file and column names), or the recipe's source_data_version for a prepared version.

twin_sha256.description: Optional. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact CSV bytes this sidecar sits beside. A reader that finds the file's bytes hash otherwise ignores the sidecar; without it, `dataset` is the match and `dataset_version` is provenance only.

prepared.description: Present only for prepared versions. Their ops are already applied to the twin, so a reader must not re-apply them.

name.description: The prepared version's dataset name (the same as `dataset`).

parent.description: The dataset the version was prepared from.

recipe_ops.description: How many recipe ops were applied to the twin, in run order. A count of ops, never of rows or patients.

columns.description: One entry per column a settled (agent_decided or clinician_confirmed) in-force decision covers. A decision over several columns appears once per column.

meaning.description: What the column means, when the decision is an interpretation with a non-role meaning (a code from data-decisions v1).

role.description: The column's role, when the decision is an interpretation with a role meaning: time, outcome or group.

op.description: The decided transformation's op name only, never its arguments (they can carry values).

decided_by.description: Who settled the decision: the agent or the clinician.

state.description: How far the decision got. Only settled states appear here; open ones are under `open`.

open.description: The in-force decisions still open: questions for the clinician. A reader keeps asking these.

question.description: The open question in the decider's own words (their rationale). It passed the output gate's identifier check before it was stored, and again before this file was written.

meaningCode.description: A data-agnostic reading of a column or a value (the non-role codes of data-decisions v1).

opCode.description: The repair vocabulary (the op codes of data-decisions v1).
